card.name: Leading digits before a thousands comma
card.fires_on: A digit in a large number written with comma separators, just before the comma that marks thousands. It fires on the digit that comes right before the first or second comma.

modes.label: Lab count thresholds
modes.description: Digit before the thousands comma in cell counts such as platelets or WBC per mm3.

modes.label: Historical or measurement figures
modes.description: Digit before the comma in production totals, heights or ratios.

card.writes: It promotes a comma as the next character and suppresses commas fused with other punctuation.
card.plain: It notices a digit in a big number where a thousands comma comes next.
